arguments.assumptions: Scenario sensitivity, not consensus or a company-observed multiple. FY2027 GAAP annual EPS assumptions use the reported FY2026 $4.90 diluted-EPS anchor and the 182-day FY2027 interim $4.85 as evidence of acceleration; figures are not an annualization. Multiples are explicit 25x/30x/35x assumptions and are held beyond the 63-session horizon solely to frame sensitivity. Dated price is split-adjusted; all scenario EPS inputs are declared split-adjusted assumptions.

cases.rationale: Assumes demand moderates and a lower valuation multiple despite reported Q2 FY2027 acceleration.
Assumes continued data-center demand converts into a full-year GAAP EPS step-up from FY2026.
Assumes sustained demand and margin resilience support both higher EPS and a premium multiple.
